spec.name: sprint24_taker_imbalance_continuation_majors_v2
spec.hypothesis: Smoothed taker-buy volume imbalance (order-flow, EFMA 2025) predicts short-horizon CONTINUATION on liquid majors (BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT); untested twice (sprint10, sprint12) due to CONFIRMED DATA-DEFECT (BTCUSD vs BTCUSDT symbol mismatch, identical failure class to the sprint11/14 SPY defect, fixed per sprint22_v2 precedent). Last untested cell in the taker_imbalance x {continuation,reversion} x {majors,altcoins} matrix; other three cells FAIL well-powered.
spec.power_argument: Back-solving sprint21 (continuation, altcoins, identical params smooth=30/z_window=1440/threshold=2.0, cap5): n=2165 validation trades / 8 symbols / ~92 validation days = ~2.9 qualifying entries/symbol/day. Applying that trigger rate to 2 majors x ~92 validation days x cap8 projects ~530 trades, clearing the 300 floor with margin even if majors trigger less often than alts. Per-trade sigma back-solved from sprint21 (mean_net -29.05bps, t=-48.61, n=2165): sigma = 29.05*sqrt(2165)/48.61 ~= 27.8bps. At n=300, 80% power, two-sided 5%: min detectable edge = 2.8*27.8/sqrt(300) ~= 4.5bps net, well below the ~26bps T2 cost floor (C0/C1) -- criteria can fail under the null.
